name: AFT DeleteItems Auto Click (abelrigm)
summary: Queue container IDs and click through AFT Delete Items.

name: AFT Edit Items — Job Automation (abelrigm)
summary: Walk an Edit Items job from a golden-format LPN list.
detail: Takes the FC Research golden-format list and runs the AFT Edit Items workflow, including confirmations, Change Container, and a live progress log. It records restricted, transshipment, and not-in-container results, and marks an LPN done before submit so a reload does not lose it.

name: LPN Deleter (abelrigm)
summary: A collapsible panel for deleting LPNs on AFT Delete Items.
detail: Adds a panel on the Delete Items page and remembers whether it was open or closed. The LPN list you are working through can be copied from the panel.

name: Dropzone Batch (abelrigm)
summary: Paste containers and one dropzone, then send each as a scan-gun burst.
detail: On AFT Move Individual Container, a panel docks to the bottom half of the page. Paste a container list and one dropzone. Start sends each container, then that dropzone, as a fast scan. The page has to change before the next scan. Skip leaves a container out for the rest of the Chicago day so it is not scanned to a dropzone again. A rejected move is skipped the same way. Containers that land are also left out until Reset done. Status sits on the right. Copy debug copies a dump when a scan does not land.

name: Apollo Audit Login Helper (abelrigm)
summary: Add a runner panel on a new Apollo audit.
detail: On Apollo's new-audit page, adds a panel for stepping through the audit instead of filling the form by hand.

name: Apollo Audit Login Helper 28796 (abelrigm)
summary: Runner panel aimed at Apollo audit 28796.
detail: Same kind of panel as the general Apollo helper, set up for audit 28796 on the new-audit page.

name: Apollo Audit Login Helper 29836 (abelrigm)
summary: Fill Apollo audit 29836, with LPN 1–3 taken from the associate's inventory history.
detail: Paste a QuickSight table of login, attribute, and percent. Choose the associate for the next audit, or leave it on the next unaudited person. Run fills audit 29836 and loads the three newest unique LPNs from that associate's FC Research inventory history, then submits.

name: Control Tower Login Finder (abelrigm)
summary: Find where pasted logins sat during each half of the shift.
detail: Next to Control Tower search, paste Amazon logins. The script returns each person's location for the first half (6:00–12:15) and the second half (12:15–6:00). Copy Debug dumps the page structure when a lookup parses wrong.

name: MEM3 Control Tower - Line Pairs (abelrigm)
summary: Place similarly named groups side by side inside each department.
detail: On MEM3 assignments, groups whose names are at least 95% similar sit on one row. The rest stack alone. Cards share the same height and width, and the layout updates only when the grouping changes.

name: MEM3 Control Tower - UPH Overlay (abelrigm)
summary: Show each associate's FCLM units per hour next to their login.
detail: On MEM3 assignments, units per hour appear beside the login, inside the associate popup, as a per-line average, and as a floor summary in the section bar.

name: Productivity Panel (abelrigm)
summary: Show each associate's rate and idle time, and refresh both together every 5 minutes.
detail: On MEM3 assignments, Primary Grading rate and idle time update on one cycle. Customer Returns uses the overall Primary Grading rate, total units divided by paid hours. BIGs uses Medium and Large EACH units divided by the hours those units took. A size’s hours are its units divided by that size’s UPH. JPH is not used. The BIGs rate reads the UNIT and UPH columns, so paid hours and JPH are left out. A blank size column does not shift Medium onto Large. On an associate row, the photo, the login, and the UPH share one line, and the idle percent sits under the UPH. A yellow pulsing yield sign sits on the login row when the associate is idle now. A red yield sign in that same top spot means an extended break, and it stays until someone clicks Engage for Extended Break. The two sign spots stay the same size either way. Extended Breaks on each line and on Total counts associates at 56% idle or more inside 8:50–9:25 or 2:20–2:55. Days use the morning and afternoon times, nights use the evening and early-morning times. A 15 minute break in that 35 minute window is 42.8% idle. The count does not go down when someone is engaged, and a person flagged on both breaks counts once. The eye, the associate popup, and the engagement details say 1st break, 2nd break, or 1st and 2nd break. The count and the engaged percent are separated by a white bar. The percent beside it is how many of those associates have been engaged: 95% and below is red, 96% through 99% is yellow, and 100% is green. One eye opens the list, with the idle minutes in the window and an Engagement button when someone already wrote the details. Extended Breaks on the top right opens that same list for the floor. In or Out stays on the photo ring. That grid stays beside the login when the row has an Override button. Each Customer Returns station is three lines: Customer Returns, then 1st Half, then 2nd Half. Those assignment columns share one width, so the photos line up from one line to the next. The employee column sits closer to the station. The rate is drawn as soon as its page arrives. Idle pages start then, four at a time, line people before BIGS, one try per person. Someone who shows up before the next cycle gets that rate and an idle page without waiting. The panel shows a countdown to the next full recalculation of rate and idle time. A menu on that countdown chooses 1, 2, 3, 4, or 5 minutes. That pass clears every rate and idle time already on the panel, then reads everyone again from scratch, including someone who was added after the last one. Each row, the line idle total, and the floor idle total update as each person comes back. BIGs is BIGS Line + Line Support. It sits under L1 Odd, Total stretches across both rows, and its rate, idle, and associates count in Total. The BIGS idle percent leaves out CRETS Waterspider and both CRETS EOL rows. Their own rows still show a rate and an idle percent. A BIGS station outside that group still shows idle on the row and stays out of the totals. Station utilization skips a station marked Disabled, so it is not listed as empty and it is not part of the percent. The utilization popup lists those stations under Disabled. Installed copies check the repository update link and open the new version when it is higher. On the MAASK authentication page, it opens the IT login chooser and clicks IT Service Login. On the menu location page it types MEM3 and presses Enter. While the problem-solve sheet scans someone in or out, the panel stops rewriting rows so Control Tower can update the station. Leaving Early is a yellow button on the associate card, above Unassign. When that person is already leaving, the time stays in red under their name, with no box around it. The next panel shows that associate's photo, name, login, and station. The time box is 00:00 and AM or PM sits on its right, at the bottom. Mark closes the panel. View Early Outs, left of Unassign Early Outs, opens who is leaving at their latest time. The list shows the total and how many leave in each quarter hour. Each row has a 42px photo, and the station is on its own lines. Clear sits on the left and asks for a confirm. Copy copies that list. A note has the same small photo, and its Clear sits on the left with a confirm. A changed time replaces the old one on that list. Marking someone again after a clear puts them back on the list. Each person appears once, at their latest time. Show History at the bottom opens only the activity from the past 12 hours. Each line starts with the name of the person who did it, then who they did it to and what happened, including who cleared someone and when. Copy early debug on that list records each mark, clear, and unassign. Automatic unassign clicks the Unassign button and stops when that menu closes, so the associate stays on the board the same as unassigning by hand. A menu that does not close is clicked again. Clicking the three-line Customer Returns station copies Customer returns 1st Half: Station 1-04 | 2nd Half: Station 1-76. If the associate is no longer at the station they were marked from, they fall off the early out and that reason is recorded. Clear removes any row on the list, including someone who already left or came back. Every computer running this script shares one leaving list, so an early out marked on one laptop shows on the others. Unassign Early Outs sits on the panel. The main panel does not show a Leaving Early button or a Time issues button. The password opens in the center. After it is accepted, that panel becomes a progress bar. Stop ends the run and lists who was unassigned and who is left. Through sets the latest leave time to unassign. 12:00 PM takes 12:00 PM and anyone earlier. It starts at the current time. Each group has Unassign Group. The password is the same, and it unassigns only the people signed in on that group. Early-out and note photos are read with the page's own styles and kept on this computer after the person leaves the station. The signed-in login is read from the Welcome line in the Control Tower header, so nobody types a name. Every mark, update, unassign, and return is recorded with that person. Enter Notes under Leaving Early on the associate card is for that person. The top of the panel does not put Enter Notes on each line. View Notes lists every note as the login, then noted, then the person or the line, then the note. Notes written on other computers are included. A note can be cleared only by the person who wrote it. Show Leaving Early, Unassign Early Outs, View Notes, and Copy debug sit in two even columns at the top right. The lowest UPH highlight skips BIGs. Idle percent still includes BIGs. A BIGs rate is red below 16, yellow from 16 through 18, and green at 19 and above. Other rates keep the 30 target.

name: MEM3 Control Tower - PS Board (abelrigm)
summary: Scan a typed login in or out of a problem-solve station on Control Tower.
detail: On MEM3 assignments, a PS board button sits on the CRET Problem Solve group and stays out of the productivity panel. The sheet places each associate on the line map, with the B station stacked on the split side. Audit PS, Grey Totes, Gatekeeper, Bigs PS, Add-Ins, and Exceptions sit on one row under the lines, each the same size as a line station. Click a station and type a login, for example abelrigm. Scan in clicks the None link, types the login into the search Control Tower opens, and clicks Assign. Scan out clicks the login and then Unassign. Scan in waits until Assign stays on that person, then clicks it once. Copy debug puts the station, the row, and any open search or Assign button on the clipboard. The sheet follows the group as the page updates. Anyone whose station is not on the sheet is listed under it.

name: FCLM Login Shift + Name Lookup (abelrigm)

name: FCLM Process Path Review (abelrigm)
summary: Review process paths from FCLM time details.

name: FCLM Table Inspector (Ruben 2.0) (abelrigm)
summary: Pin Function Rollup values per tab, including live and intraday windows.
detail: Keeps a pinned value for each tab on Function Rollup. You can watch the live number or fetch an intraday window.

summary: Double-right-click an element to copy its HTML and locators.

name: Excel Identity Lookup (abelrigm)
summary: Check a name, login, employee ID, or badge against the open SharePoint workbook.

name: Ultimate Tampermonkey (abelrigm)
summary: A shared foundation for the QuickSight and FCLM scripts.
detail: One userscript that loads as a modular base across those sites, with saved settings and clipboard helpers the smaller dashboard scripts grew out of.

name: Dropzone Barcode Label Generator (abelrigm)
summary: Build dropzone labels with Code 128 and Aztec barcodes.
detail: A panel for warehouse dropzone labels. Adjust the barcode ratio and border color, then print. Settings are saved for the next run.

name: Camera 2D Barcode Scanner (abelrigm)
summary: Read 2D and linear barcodes with the laptop camera, and force a capture if it misses.
detail: On any page, a button opens the laptop camera and keeps reading QR, Data Matrix, PDF417, Aztec, and linear codes such as Code 128. The picture is not mirrored. Capture forces the current frame. Copy debug copies a dump when a label will not read. The value can be copied or typed into the last text field. The camera turns off when the panel closes.

name: Sticker Roll (abelrigm)
summary: Print a side roll of stickers from a pasted list, with a barcode and two click colors.
detail: On any page, a small sticker button at the top center opens a panel that matches the stickers. Print builds a roll on the left or right. Each sticker shows a linear barcode above the value, stretched nearly to the sticker edges. A click turns it the first color, the next click the second color, and a third click returns it to white. Colors and the paint mode are set in the panel. The panel close button is red and hides only the panel. The printed list stays. An X on the printed list removes that list. Where you have scrolled on that list is saved, so a refresh stays on the same barcode. Drag the handle at the bottom of the roll to make the stickers and the roll thicker or thinner. Name a list to save it. That list shows in History on other tabs. Export writes the values.

name: Printmon2 Bulk Print Helper (abelrigm)

detail: On Printmon2, prompts for values copied from Excel, fills the bulk text area, and clicks Print Multiple Labels.

name: Liquidation Sort Helper (abelrigm)

name: ONT Base Piles Audit Workspace (abelrigm)

Sortable counts convert at pallet 150 and tote 5. EOS reports Add Ins, PS, Exceptions, and the total. Add Ins includes shuttles. Problem Solve and Exceptions do not. Misships, AR BIGS, Refurb, Audit, and ADS stay out of that total. The counts stay on that audit.
